facts.business: Shreyans Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of writing and printing paper using agro-based raw materials such as wheat straw, operating two manufacturing units in Punjab with a combined installed capacity of approximately 94,000 metric tonnes per annum.

capacity_or_capex.item: Combined installed capacity of two manufacturing units
Right of Use Asset - Land additions

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No material misstatement of other information; nothing to report in this regard.

key_risks: Availability and cost of raw materials (agricultural residues)
Increasing regulatory requirements and environmental compliance obligations
Competition from domestic and international manufacturers
Seasonal fluctuations in wheat straw availability and pricing
Dependence on agricultural harvesting seasons, climatic conditions, and cropping patterns
facts.related_party_note: The Company has granted unsecured loans to companies (Rs 250 lakhs during the year, Rs 150 lakhs outstanding), firms (Rs 87.29 lakhs during the year and outstanding), and employees (Rs 99.57 lakhs during the year, Rs 61.74 lakhs outstanding). Investments made in mutual funds during the year. All loans are prima facie not prejudicial to the Company's interest, with regular repayments and no overdue amounts.
